Dialogs.Dialog: Hey... if you want, want to study at my place？ Tests are coming up, right？
Want to study at my place？ For the tests. I bet you haven't started yet.
Then, after school. Come over to my place, okay？
Okay. Then, after school, come to my place, okay？
I see. Don't come crying to me if you regret it later, okay？
I see, you'll work hard on your own. Good boy, good boy.
Huh, fancy seeing you here... oh right, if you have time, want to study for the tests at my place now？
Studying for tests, huh. It is that time, but...
Huh, fancy seeing you here... ah, how's test prep going？ Want to study at my place？
Come to think of it, it's about time to study for tests...
Huh？ What a coincidence. ...Oh, I just had a great idea. Let's have a study session at my place now. No good？
Right, the exams are coming up...
Okay... then come over to my place later. I'll be waiting.
Then get ready and meet at my place. Don't be too late, okay？
Then, see you later. Let's study thoroughly today.
I see. It was sudden, huh. Sorry...
You're turning me down. Hmm... just kidding. Sorry for springing it on you.
Oh my. I got turned down. Too bad. Next time, then.
There's something I don't get in my studies. Want to study together？
Sure, though I'm not confident I can teach you. In my room.
There's something I don't get in my studies. Want to study together？
Hehe, then come to my room. I'll teach you.
There's something I don't get in my studies. Want to study together？
Then, in my room. It's like I'm your tutor.
It's your first time inside, right？ It's a little embarrassing...
Come to think of it, it's your first time coming in. No mischief, okay？
Hehe... your first time in. I'm kind of nervous.
Don't go staring around my room like last time, okay？
I didn't... well, pardon the intrusion.
Welcome, welcome. I've been waiting so eagerly. Hehe.
Exaggerating again... well, pardon the intrusion.
It's just a normal room, right？ There's nothing interesting, so don't look around too much, okay？
In my room, you sit still. That's the rule.
Hehe... nervous？ You can relax more.
It's still a bit unsettling, huh... hehe.
Hey. Don't look around the room like that. It's pretty embarrassing...
Still nervous？ Actually, me too. It's hard to get used to, huh.
You can sit there. Let's start.
Come on, sit down quick. ...What should we start with？
Well, shall we start our study session？
Okay, I'm going to keep them coming, okay？
Three questions. If you get them all right, maybe... I'll give you a reward？
And it's not even hard... hehe.
Oh, fine. Then this one's a pass...
Ah, amazing. All correct. I'll give you... a reward.
All correct. You can do it when you try. Then I have to give you a reward... right.
You got them all. Hehe... then, your reward is...
Hehe. This time's reward is this...
Wait here, I'll be right back.
Too bad... so close. Just one more...
One wrong. No reward for you.
You got one wrong. No reward... okay？
What do you want to do？ Once more？
Seems you weren't in great form...
Hehe. At this rate, I might have to really drill it into you？
Don't mind, don't mind. You can't let this get you down, okay？
Yes. Not giving up is what matters.
This isn't really helping you study, is it？
Oh, fine. Then I'll give you a little more motivation.
...Can I come a little closer to you？
Like this... what do you think？
This is the outfit you gave me... what do you think？ Does it suit me？
Does this outfit look familiar？ Then, may I hear your thoughts？
Here. As your reward, I put on the clothes you gave me. What do you think？
Something like this, once in a while... what do you think？
Well, how is it？ A different me than usual... just kidding.
I tried wearing something like this. Hehehe... happy？
That's enough, right... okay？ This is really embarrassing... okay？
Okay, that's all the service. Hehe, giving me those longing eyes won't work.
Okay, all done. If I kept it on forever, it wouldn't be special, right？
What do you think？ If you get them all right next time too, maybe... hehe.
Geez, this is special, you know？
Does this... motivate you a little？
Do you think it suits me？
Geez... don't look at me like that.
How long are you going to look？
Ugh... it's really embarrassing, you know？
Geez... you're looking way too long.
What？ Don't look at weird places... okay？
You don't have to look so intently.
Maybe because I'm wearing this. My heart's racing more than usual...
In an outfit like this... it's a little embarrassing, but...
Do you... like this kind of outfit？
That was a pretty good study session, wasn't it？
You worked hard, so you get a gold star.
You need to try a little harder, right？
I'm a little worried about your tests at this rate...
Seems you weren't in good form today... but yes, it'll work out somehow. Right？
Geez, this has me worried. Study properly at home too, okay？
Then, good luck on your tests. Me too... hehe.
Let's wrap up test studying here... want to head home？
Then wait a moment. I'll show you something nice.
Yeah. It was a good study session.
I don't know if that really counted as studying... but if you get the chance, come again.
Today... things got kind of weird halfway through, huh.
